name: ⚓ Anchored [UPDATE]
desc:
Hack panels, avoid deadly machines, and survive alongside your team as you climb floor by floor through The Anchorage. Every floor is harder than the last. Every decision matters.

Leon, the engineer who created this place, now guides you as you fight to break it. The higher you go, the harder it gets, with stronger enemies, new challenges, and discover hidden pieces of the world's past.


[ 🛠️ This game is in Alpha. Everything is subject to change, the game is still in its testing phase. Expect bugs. ]
